en: ...Is everyone ready?
Not like we have choice, right?

Kehehe... You are quick to understand.
It's as though Monokuma has you trained.

We got nothin' to worry about. Right, assholes?
We'll figure out the culprit, won't we?

Of course we don't need to worry. The top
suspect is super obvious this time.
...Riiiight, Himiko?

How dare you bully Himiko, you degenerate!
You want me to Aikido-chop your head off, huh!?
That's...not even Aikido anymore, is it?

This matter will be discussed <CLT=cltSTRONG>in due time<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
You should save your arguments until then.

Yeah, let's put an end to this 
at the class trial.
Yeah...you're right.

Shuichi...before we head over there, let me give
you some advice, hero-to-sidekick.

If you want to give up, wait until after you've
done everything you possibly can!

Wait, no. That's still no good...
Okay! I won't forgive you if you give up!
You got it?
Yeah...got it, Kaito.

<CLT=cltMIND>He's right...I can't give up.
I made a promise to Kaede.
Gonta...not wanna suspect friends...

This case will be sooo easy. Especially
with how obvious the top suspect is.
...Riiiight, Himiko?

I hear males pick on girls they like to get their
attention! Which means Kokichi must like Himiko!
Huh!? How'd you know!?

Actually, why don't we focus on the class
trial and save that conversation for later?

Nee-heehee... This is turning out to be
not so boring after all.

This murder...was also triggered by 
Monokuma's <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>, was it not?

Which means...there is a reason the culprit 
was desperate to live, yes?

And Ryoma, who became the victim...
had no reason to live, correct?
What are you implying?

To kill because you have a reason to live...
To die because you have no reason to live...
Which, I wonder...is correct?

You're thinking too hard about it...
Living things just gotta live.

Anyway, no matter what happens to us, 
we gotta live!

Yeah... You don't really need a reason to live.
That's just the icing on the cake.
<CLT=cltMIND>A reason to live...

I did not calculate that we would gather
here under these circumstances again...

What would Kaede say if she saw us right
now...?

This matter will be discussed in due time.
We should save our arguments until then.
Nyeh... Nyeeeh...

Th-This whole thing is sh-shakin' like
a big ol' vibrator!
H-Himiko's scared! Poor little thing!
Nyeh! Nyeeeeeeh!
Th-This v-v-vibration i-is p-perfect...!

Qu-Quit looking at Himiko like some
kind of degenerate male!
...Sorry, but I don't know anything.

If you think a child caregiver can help solve
a murder case...then we're all in trouble.

Himiko...is NOT the culprit.
No way, no how.

I know Himiko better than anyone!
I know all her secrets!

I know her gender! Her hair color!
Even her height!
<CLT=cltMIND>None of those are secrets...

Himiko's so suspicious, she's gotta be 
a red herring, right?

But I don't even know where to start
unraveling the truth...

Aah... I should've played more 
point-and-click adventure games...
Nyahahaha! We have nothing to worry about!

Atua sees all. His divine deduction will
solve this mystery right away!

Hey, Detective Dumbass! You've pinpointed
a possible culprit, right!?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't turn back...
I have to keep pressing forward!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*rumble, rumble!*

<CLT=cltMIND>The door appeared before us with pomp,
as if sending heroes off to war.

<CLT=cltMIND>After a pause...we all stepped
toward the door.

<CLT=cltMIND>We were silent.
All I could hear was our unsteady breathing.
<CLT=cltMIND>Just as we passed through the door...
<CLT=cltMIND>It started up again.
<CLT=cltMIND>Normally, I wouldn't mind the shaking...

<CLT=cltMIND>But I'm feeling especially
sensitive to it now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Each of us felt that trembling through
our entire bodies as we sank further still.

<CLT=cltMIND>Without sure footing, I'm positive
I would have fallen as well.

<CLT=cltMIND>My breathing was becoming more ragged,
my heart pounded harder and harder...

<CLT=cltMIND>Just when I thought I would
pass out from the nerves—
<CLT=cltMIND>The elevator came to a stop.
<CLT=cltMIND>But this wasn't the end, no.
<CLT=cltMIND>It was only just beginning.
